q1_wandering.question: Has the patient wandered off, gotten lost outside, or failed to recognise familiar surroundings recently?

q2_immediate_danger.question: Is the patient currently missing or in immediate physical danger?

q3_night_wandering.question: Does the disorientation or wandering mostly occur during evening or night hours (Sundowning)?

q4_memory_loss.question: Has the patient shown noticeable difficulty remembering close family names, recent conversations, or daily routines?

q5_adl_independence.question: Is the patient struggling with basic daily self-care (such as eating, bathing, or getting dressed)?

q6_medication.question: Can the patient manage and take their prescribed medications reliably on their own?

q7_mood_behavior.question: Has the patient shown sudden unexplained agitation, paranoia, hallucinations, or social withdrawal?

outcome_emergency_asha.title: Emergency Alert — Active Wandering
outcome_emergency_asha.recommendation: CRITICAL EMERGENCY: Initiate immediate community search. Contact the local ASHA worker and primary health center emergency team immediately. Do not leave the patient unattended.
outcome_emergency_asha.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Urgent Alert: High-priority immediate dispatch flagged in offline sync log.

outcome_sundowning_asha.title: High Risk — Nocturnal Disorientation (Sundowning)
outcome_sundowning_asha.recommendation: Patient demonstrates severe evening agitation and disorientation. Keep hallways well-lit, install gentle door alarms/chimes, maintain regular evening routines, and consult the ASHA worker for an immediate home assessment.
outcome_sundowning_asha.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Notification: Nocturnal wandering support flagged.

outcome_wandering_monitoring.title: Moderate Risk — Disorientation Episode
outcome_wandering_monitoring.recommendation: Provide an identification wristband or card with family telephone and address. Request a routine ASHA community visit to evaluate home safety.
outcome_wandering_monitoring.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Notification: Safety & ID check requested.

outcome_moderate_dementia_asha.title: Significant Functional Decline in Daily Activities
outcome_moderate_dementia_asha.recommendation: Impairment in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) indicates advancing cognitive decline. Patient requires daily caregiver assistance and a clinical review by a PHC medical officer. ASHA worker flagged for caregiver support counseling.
outcome_moderate_dementia_asha.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Notification: Home care assistance & caregiver respite flagged.

outcome_medication_risk.title: Medication Non-Adherence Risk
outcome_medication_risk.recommendation: Patient cannot safely self-administer medications. All medications must be locked and supervised by a primary caregiver using labeled day/night pill organizers. ASHA worker alerted for medication adherence audit.
outcome_medication_risk.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Notification: Medication audit scheduled.

outcome_mild_cognitive_impairment.title: Mild Cognitive Changes — Monitoring & Engagement
outcome_mild_cognitive_impairment.recommendation: Early memory lapses detected without impairment in daily life. Continue structured daily cognitive exercises (Memory Match, Daily Sequence), maintain social connections, and keep a calm routine. Re-assess in 30 days.
outcome_mild_cognitive_impairment.ashaNotice: No immediate ASHA dispatch required. Logged for routine monitoring.

outcome_behavioral_changes.title: Behavioral & Psychological Symptoms
outcome_behavioral_changes.recommendation: Sudden behavioral changes may stem from discomfort, infection, or dementia progression. Maintain gentle non-confrontational communication, reduce loud stimuli, and consult the ASHA worker for an evaluation.
outcome_behavioral_changes.ashaNotice: ASHA Worker Notification: Behavioral assessment request flagged.

outcome_healthy_baseline.title: Cognitive Baseline Stable
outcome_healthy_baseline.recommendation: No acute red-flag cognitive or safety symptoms detected. Continue regular physical activity, social engagement, and brain-stimulating games. Perform this check again next month or if any changes occur.
